key_path: Agentic-commerce path (fastest): `npm install -g @shopify/ucp-cli` + `claude plugin install shopify-ai-toolkit@claude-plugins-official`; `ucp profile init --name agent`; `ucp catalog search ...` works with NO credential (anonymous tier). Global Catalog MCP tools/list answered unauthenticated in our probe.
For Token tier: sign up / log in at dev.shopify.com (Dev Dashboard) -> Catalogs -> 'Get an API key' -> name -> Create -> copy client_id/client_secret -> exchange for a JWT bearer token at runtime.
Admin API path: Dev Dashboard account -> create free dev store -> `shopify app init` (Shopify CLI opens browser login) -> app installed on dev store -> Admin API access token.
Merchant path with no developer work: add Claude connector https://setup.shopify.com/mcp (OAuth, CIMD) -> sign in to Shopify -> manage store / even create a business before a store exists.
human_gates: manual_approval (only for Token-tier complete_checkout permission / higher rate limits via Shopify rep)
waitlist (Universal Cart API early access Google Form)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_login: yes - Shopify CLI browser login; UCP CLI profile init is local and needs no account
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes (CIMD, not RFC7591) - setup.shopify.com AS metadata advertises client_id_metadata_document_supported:true, token auth 'none', PKCE S256
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - granular Admin scopes (write_products, read_all_orders...), buyer-linked tokens, read_global_api_orders
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - catalog anonymous tier, dev stores and API keys are free

remote.name: Global Catalog MCP (UCP)
remote.auth: anonymous / signed (UCP agent profile) / bearer JWT from Dev Dashboard; 5 rps per client default

remote.name: Storefront Catalog/Cart/Checkout/Order MCP (UCP)
remote.auth: requires meta.ucp-agent.profile URL; complete_checkout only for trusted Token tier

Shopify AI Toolkit plugin/skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity, OpenClaw
mcp.directories: Claude directory: 'Shopify' connector (Anthropic verified, setup.shopify.com/mcp). Toolkit is in claude-plugins-official and openai-curated Codex plugins. Agentic Storefronts syndicate merchants into ChatGPT/Gemini/Copilot (secondary sources).
agentic_commerce_protocols: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, co-developed with Google; spec version 2026-08-25)
OpenAI ACP / Instant Checkout historically (reported wound down Mar 2026 - secondary source)

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: www.shopify.com/llms.txt exists (marketing). shopify.dev/llms.txt returns the HTML app shell (no real llms.txt) - gap.
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every shopify.dev page has `.md` twin + <link rel=alternate type=text/markdown>
docs_for_agents.openapi: GraphQL schemas exposed via Dev MCP; no OpenAPI (GraphQL-first)
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: shopify.com and shopify.dev: no AI-specific blocks (only CCBot group mirrors * rules); open

score_justification: Anonymous product-search MCP + CLI + plugins in both Claude and Codex marketplaces + CIMD-based store connector; a coding agent can make a real catalog call with zero human steps.
best_practice: Tiered trust (anonymous -> signed profile -> token) lets agents start with no credential and upgrade; every doc page has a .md twin.
biggest_gap: Completing checkout in-agent requires trusted-tier approval (most agents hand off to continue_url); Universal Cart behind a Google-Form waitlist; shopify.dev lacks a real llms.txt.
